shots.focal_element: Two small split-colour orbs that converge around a typed-on 'v4 Turbo' label, then a centred dotted-particle face/head that shimmers while a two-line karaoke caption beneath it highlights the spoken words
on_screen_text: [friendly] Uh, hi there, I'm calling to check on a prior authorization for medication for my mother. It should
be under Doctor Zhihao Qin , and the medication is "Semaglutide". [checking] Okay, Doctor Zhihao Qin ,
semaglutide. Got it. [professional] Okay, great. So the request came through on Monday, one milligram
weekly, and it's been approved for twelve months. Thank you. Actually, would you be able to provide the
medicine information in Mandarin so that my mother can understand it? Her English is not so good.
shots.typography: 'v4 Turbo' in a small bold geometric sans, sentence/mixed case, typed on character by character; captions in a small regular-weight grotesque sans, sentence case, normal tracking, centred two-line blocks with the currently spoken words switched to a darker/saturated weight and bracketed audio-tag cues ([friendly], [checking], [professional]) inline; later caption blocks are Chinese characters (too small to quote verbatim, not counted). Closing giant 'v4' glyphs in a heavy rounded sans. Font names unknown (low-confidence guess: a neo-grotesque like Inter).
shots.what_happens: Opening on a flat off-white field, two small half-and-half orbs emit fading ring pulses at the left and right edges and slide inward while 'v4 Turbo' types on between them (words w236-w237 '11V4 turbo'); the label breaks into a dispersing particle cloud that resolves into a dotted, shimmering face. For the rest of the shot a phone-call demo plays (w238-w316: prior authorization, Dr. Zhihao Qing, semaglutide, request in Mandarin) with karaoke captions paging every two lines; from about 2:16 the captions switch to Chinese for the untranscribed Mandarin reply. Near the end the particle face dissolves and huge blurred 'v' and '4' glyphs sweep into frame, leading into s011.
shots.build_rebuild: On an off-white canvas, animate a canvas/WebGL point cloud sampled from a face mesh with per-point noise jitter, and below it render a two-line caption that pages by line pair and toggles each word's colour/weight active as its word timestamp (w238-w316) is reached.

shots.focal_element: An oversized, heavily defocused '4' glyph with a green-to-black gradient filling most of the frame, with the edge of the red 'v' stroke at left
shots.transition_other: Continuation of the giant-glyph camera sweep begun at the end of s010; the cut detector split the motion-blurred move rather than a designed cut
shots.typography: Single giant numeral in a heavy, rounded geometric sans, extremely out of focus with film grain; colour from code.
shots.what_happens: A brief (about 0.6 s) camera pass across the enormous, blurred '4' of the 'v4' mark with a swoosh in the audio (x094), bridging from the turbo demo into the closing line that begins at w317 'The next frontier'.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale a 'v4' text layer to roughly 8x the frame, apply a strong Gaussian blur plus grain overlay, and tween its x-position across the frame in about 0.6 s with an ease-in-out so the '4' fills the screen mid-move.
